user_prompt: We need a way to automatically flag travel expense reports that violate our policy thresholds—like when someone books a flight that's more than 15% above the lowest available option or books a hotel outside our preferred vendor list—so our finance team can route those for manager pre-approval before they hit the approval workflow instead of catching violations after the fact.
